base: T3_rev6 row 38 / N2 -- the ONLY base observed to give the CORRECT temperature direction
rationale: T10 scanned E_a0_conv over [1.55,1.95] on the T9-theta1 base and got 0 crossover hits at all 12 values, with f_100 LOWER at 350 C than at 300 C everywhere -- the inverse of the measured trend.  Mechanism: raising T grows 1/2<111> faster than it converts it (d_111 = 10.39 nm at 350 C vs 1.10 nm at 300 C at E_a0=1.55), so more 1/2<111> clears the 1 nm TEM cutoff and dilutes the filtered ratio, beating the Arrhenius speed-up of conversion. The row-38 base instead gave f_100 0.4275 -> 0.8605 across 300->330 C at matched dose, i.e. the correct sign.  The two bases differ in nine parameters so the sign cannot be attributed from that pair; this scan first establishes whether row 38 keeps the correct sign at the 300/350 pair and G=1e-7, and if so locates its crossover E_a0.
